name: heat-safety-dispatcher
description: Dispatches autonomous outbound conversational phone calls to outdoor workers when extreme heat or thermal strain thresholds are breached.

phone_number.description: E.164 formatted recipient phone number (e.g. +12135550192 or +923172532350)

worker_name.description: Name of the worker, site foreman, or safety officer

site_name.description: Job site location or facility name

temperature_f.description: Measured ground-level or ambient temperature in Fahrenheit

work_rest_ratio.description: OSHA-mandated work/rest ratio (e.g. '15 min work / 45 min rest')

hydration_liters_per_hour.description: Mandatory hydration quota in liters per hour (e.g. 1.5)

cooling_refuge_direction.description: Direction to the coolest measured shade zone (e.g. 'North-East canopy')
